name: ChronoQA
description: The expanding use of large language models in intelligent workflows has triggered rapid advancement in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). Despite their success with short-form video, existing models still fall short when tasked with long-duration sequences. Temporal grounding, which involves localizing when an event occurs within a video, is a persistent weakness of video language models (VLMs), in part because existing training data provides answer supervision but lacks temporal evidence supervision.
